overloadPatches.semanticRole: Populates an array with the names (or paths) of documents present at a given folder/volume location, with options controlling path format and recursion.

overloadMerges.note: documents is a filled/returned array (docs: 'Names of the documents present at this location'); autoparse defaults all params to direction:in.

params.name: pathname
params.description: Absolute pathname to volume, directory, or folder

params.name: documents
params.description: Receives the names (or paths, depending on options) of documents found; empty array if none found

params.name: options
params.description: Bit-combinable constants from the System Documents theme: Recursive parsing=1, Absolute path=2, Posix path=4, Ignore invisible=8; defaults to plain document names only when omitted

constraints: In relative mode with Recursive parsing (option 1 only), subfolder document paths begin with ':' (macOS) or '\' (Windows).
In relative mode with Posix path (option 4 only), paths do not start with '/'; in absolute mode with Posix path (option 4 + 2), paths always begin with '/'.
An invalid pathname generates a file manager error, interceptable via ON ERR CALL.
